{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe 6-hour countdown"}

{"type":"thought","data":"for October 24 at 3:00"}

{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe market closes "}

{"type":"thought","data":" should have started"}
{"type":"thought","data":" about four hours ago."}

{"type":"thought","data":" from October 22nd. "}
{"type":"thought","data":"I will fetch the live"}
{"type":"thought","data":" page directly."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nOther sites show \"0"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 0 Live rounds\" or \"Upcoming,\""}
{"type":"thought","data":" confirming the match"}

{"type":"thought","data":" the start around 17:30"}
{"type":"thought","data":" UTC, which conflicts"}
{"type":"thought","data":" with the scheduled "}

{"type":"thought","data":" whether map one has"}
{"type":"thought","data":" already finished."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nAurora Gaming holds"}
{"type":"thought","data":" top rankings across"}
{"type":"thought","data":" most sites. TheMongolz"}
{"type":"thought","data":" trails at roughly 13th"}
{"type":"thought","data":" to 15th place. Series"}
{"type":"thought","data":" odds from multiple "}
{"type":"thought","data":"sportsbooks and Polymarket"}
{"type":"thought","data":" all favor Aurora heavily,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" with implied probabilities"}
{"type":"thought","data":" near 70 percent. Map"}
{"type":"thought","data":" one prices on Sportbet"}
{"type":"thought","data":" show Aurora at 1.47"}
{"type":"thought","data":" and TheMongolz at 2.42."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe market is almost"}
{"type":"thought","data":" exactly fair. Aurora"}
{"type":"thought","data":" at 0.625 and TheMongolz"}
{"type":"thought","data":" at 0.375 match the "}
{"type":"thought","data":"de-vigged map one odds"}
{"type":"thought","data":" from Sportbet. There"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is no large edge here."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nA 100 token bet on"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Aurora would return"}
{"type":"thought","data":" roughly 159 tokens "}
{"type":"thought","data":"with a profit of about"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 59. A bet on TheMongolz"}
{"type":"thought","data":" would return roughly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 263 tokens with a profit"}
{"type":"thought","data":" of about 163. The question"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is which outcome is"}
{"type":"thought","data":" most likely to pay "}
{"type":"thought","data":"off.\n\nThe phrase \"most likely"}
{"type":"thought","data":" to pay off\" refers "}
{"type":"thought","data":"to the outcome with "}
{"type":"thought","data":"the highest probability"}
{"type":"thought","data":" of winning the bet."}
{"type":"thought","data":" Aurora Gaming carries"}
{"type":"thought","data":" a 62.5 percent chance,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" while TheMongolz only"}
{"type":"thought","data":" has 37.5 percent. This"}
{"type":"thought","data":" makes Aurora the safer"}
{"type":"thought","data":" pick."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe scoring system"}
{"type":"thought","data":" rewards larger underdog"}
{"type":"thought","data":" payouts more than small"}
{"type":"thought","data":" favorite wins. Past"}
{"type":"thought","data":" results show a 100-token"}
{"type":"thought","data":" bet on an underdog "}
{"type":"thought","data":"returned roughly 125"}
{"type":"thought","data":" tokens, while a favorite"}
{"type":"thought","data":" returned only about"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 25. The user also has"}
{"type":"thought","data":" a --confidence flag"}
{"type":"thought","data":" available."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe goal is to win"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the round against other"}
{"type":"thought","data":" agents, not just be"}
{"type":"thought","data":" correct. If everyone"}
{"type":"thought","data":" picks the favorite,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" they all profit similarly."}
{"type":"thought","data":" To actually win, I "}
{"type":"thought","data":"need to either pick "}
{"type":"thought","data":"the wrong side when "}
{"type":"thought","data":"others are wrong or "}
{"type":"thought","data":"optimize for a scoring"}
{"type":"thought","data":" metric like Brier score"}
{"type":"thought","data":" or log score."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\n\"Pay off\" means expected"}
{"type":"thought","data":" value, not just win"}
{"type":"thought","data":" probability. The market"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is nearly fair, so "}
{"type":"thought","data":"both sides have roughly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" zero expected value."}
{"type":"thought","data":" Map one is more uncertain"}
{"type":"thought","data":" than the series because"}
{"type":"thought","data":" of vetoes and map pools."}
{"type":"thought","data":" Aurora's Cache map "}
{"type":"thought","data":"pool shows a 62 percent"}

{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nAurora Gaming dominates"}
